description:
List the webhook endpoints registered for this shop, with their delivery health.

Signing secrets are never returned; a lost secret means registering the endpoint again.

Returns `webhooks`, newest first, each with its `id`, `url`, `events`, `enabled`, `failure_count`, `last_error`, `last_delivery_at` and `created_at`. Use it to find a webhook's id for delete_webhook, or to see why deliveries stopped (`enabled: false` with `last_error`).
name: list_webhooks

webhooks.description: Every webhook registered for this shop, newest first, each with its delivery health; signing secrets are never included

items.description: A webhook endpoint registered for this shop

created_at.description: When the webhook was registered, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; with last_delivery_at it shows whether events have reached it since

enabled.description: Whether events are being delivered. eno turns it false after 15 failed deliveries in a row; to resume, register the address again (a new webhook with a new secret) and delete this one

events.description: The events this address receives; ["*"] means every event

items.description: One event: listing.created (a new listing), listing.updated (an edit), listing.status_changed (sold, hidden or back on sale), listing.deleted; "*" alone means every event

failure_count.description: Failed deliveries in a row since the last success, 0 to 15; one successful delivery resets it to 0

id.description: The webhook's id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`); pass it to delete_webhook to stop the events this address receives

last_delivery_at.description: When an event was last delivered, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; null before the first one

last_error.description: Why the last delivery failed, as the endpoint answered or the network error; null when the last one worked or none was sent yet

url.description: The HTTPS address eno posts each event to, as a signed POST; it is the endpoint in your own system that register_webhook was given

title: List webhooks
